name: Pixel Art Studio — Sprite Editor
summary: Browser pixel art sprite editor study with pencil, eraser, fill and eyedropper tools, a 32×32 canvas and a 32-color palette.
description: A self-contained HTML sprite editor study (v0.39) from the Fable 5.1 100 HTML Files set. Built around a 32×32 canvas at 14 px zoom with a tool palette (pencil, eraser, fill, eyedropper, line, mirror), keyboard shortcuts for zoom, undo and redo, grid size and zoom controls, a 32-color palette with custom colors, and 1× / 2× preview of the loaded starter sprite.
